Only downloads image assets when asset_types filter is set

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'asset_types' => ['image'], 'download_assets' => true }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.assets.length.inspect
puts result.assets[0].asset_category.inspect
```
